purpose: 按题面示例原样复现（只用公开 API）。修复前：先打印 input: 1 (128, 128) raw getpixel: 1 extrema: (1, 1)（静态推断：base 里 color=1 按字节 1 存储，不是 255），然后抛出 Traceback，最后一行是 OSError: not supported for this image mode，退出码 1。修复后：退出码 0，output 为 mode 1、尺寸 (128, 128)。后面几行只供参考，不做断言：若实现按 255-v 或按位取反，raw 值为 254、extrema (254, 254)、equals all-black 为 False、L extrema 为 (255, 255)，也就是按 1-bit 语义仍是全白；若实现把非零当白并输出 0/255，则分别为 0、(0, 0)、True、(0, 0)。题面没有规定这一点，见 public_read.md 的 R8。
cmd:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -c 'from PIL import Image, ImageOps
im = Image.new("1", (128, 128), color=1)
print("input:", im.mode, im.size, "raw getpixel:", im.getpixel((0, 0)), "extrema:", im.getextrema())
out = ImageOps.invert(im)
print("output:", out.mode, out.size, "raw getpixel:", out.getpixel((0, 0)), "extrema:", out.getextrema())
print("output equals all-black (tobytes):", out.tobytes() == Image.new("1", (128, 128), 0).tobytes())
print("output as L extrema:", out.convert("L").getextrema())'

purpose: 检查不依赖实现取舍的 1-bit 反相语义：输入只含规范值 0/255，一张 8x1 位图 0xA5，另一张是 hopper.ppm 转成的 1 模式图。修复前：先打印 in: [255, 0, 255, 0, 0, 255, 0, 255]，然后在 ImageOps.invert 处抛 OSError: not supported for this image mode，退出码 1。修复后：退出码 0，打印 out: 1 (8, 1) [0, 255, 0, 255, 255, 0, 255, 0] 和 OK。断言内容：输出 mode 为 1、尺寸不变；打包后逐位取反（0xA5 变 0x5A，hopper 每字节异或 0xFF）；反相两次复原；输入图未被原地修改。输出原始值是否只含 0/255 只打印（canonical 0/255 这一项），不做断言。
cmd:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -c 'from PIL import Image, ImageOps
im = Image.frombytes("1", (8, 1), bytes([0xA5]))
print("in:", [im.getpixel((x, 0)) for x in range(8)])
out = ImageOps.invert(im)
vals = [out.getpixel((x, 0)) for x in range(8)]
print("out:", out.mode, out.size, vals, "canonical 0/255:", set(vals) <= {0, 255})
assert out.mode == "1" and out.size == (8, 1)
assert out.tobytes() == bytes([0x5A]), out.tobytes()
assert im.tobytes() == bytes([0xA5])
src = Image.open("Tests/images/hopper.ppm").convert("1")
inv = ImageOps.invert(src)
assert inv.mode == "1" and inv.size == src.size == (128, 128)
assert inv.tobytes() == bytes(b ^ 0xFF for b in src.tobytes())
assert ImageOps.invert(inv).tobytes() == src.tobytes()
print("OK: canonical 0/255 mode 1 images invert bit-for-bit, input untouched")'

purpose: 确认需要保留的旧行为：L 与 RGB 反相仍是逐通道 255-v，且输出模式不变。修复前后都应打印 OK: L/RGB invert unchanged，退出码 0；修复后若失败，说明改动波及了 L/RGB 路径。
cmd:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -c 'from PIL import Image, ImageOps
assert ImageOps.invert(Image.new("L", (2, 2), 10)).getpixel((0, 0)) == 245
assert ImageOps.invert(Image.new("RGB", (2, 2), (10, 20, 30))).getpixel((0, 0)) == (245, 235, 225)
h = Image.open("Tests/images/hopper.ppm")
h.load()
hl = h.convert("L")
assert ImageOps.invert(hl).mode == "L" and ImageOps.invert(h).mode == "RGB"
assert ImageOps.invert(hl).tobytes() == bytes(255 - b for b in hl.tobytes())
assert ImageOps.invert(h).tobytes() == bytes(255 - b for b in h.tobytes())
print("OK: L/RGB invert unchanged")'
